csv_project_name: Conslt for Comprehensive Safety Action Plan(SS4A)
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Pooler, (hereinafter referred to as CITY ), a municipality within the State of Georgia, is seeking proposals for a Comprehensive Safety Action Plan (Safety Action Plan). The CITY is seeking professional consulting services to prepare a Comprehensive Safe Streets and Roads for All (SS4A) Safety Action Plan focused on reducing and eliminating roadway fatalities and serious injuries on all public roadways within the CITY limits, including both State routes and locally maintained streets.
